laws.rule: Islas Marietas National Park opens Tuesday to Sunday, 8 am to 6 pm; Playa del Amor (Hidden Beach) opens Wednesday to Sunday, 8 am to 5 pm. Visits are only with boats and guides authorised by CONANP, the federal protected-areas agency.
laws.heading: Comisión Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas

laws.rule: Islas Marietas National Park: CONANP's visitor rules say follow guides and rangers; a life jacket is compulsory in the water; no alcohol; no rubbish; don't take or introduce animals; no single-use plastics; use environment-friendly sunscreen at least 30 minutes before entering the water; and no footwear in water or beach activities.

Islas Marias Biosphere Reserve: CONANP's visitor rules say don't take plants, animals, shells or coral; don't feed or interact with wildlife; no pets other than assistance or medical animals; no campfires; complete the island biosecurity protocol; don't litter, including cigarette butts; and follow guides and Navy personnel.

Nayarit charges a state lodging tax (Impuesto al Hospedaje) on hotels, campgrounds, caravan parks, timeshare and similar lodging, including all-inclusive packages (at least 40% of the package price counts as lodging). The provider adds it to the guest's bill as a separate line. The rate is set by the state revenue law each year; this year's rate was not checked (Ley de Hacienda del Estado, art. 55, 58, 59, 61 and 62). Text held on OJN, last reform 2 December 2014.

Nayarit's mobility law requires motorbike riders to wear a helmet whenever the bike is moving, and any passenger to wear one too. Headphones are banned and riding on footpaths is banned. Bikes under 250 cc may not use central lanes, tunnels, underpasses or fast roads (Ley de Movilidad, art. 142; helmet types in art. 143). Text held on OJN, last reform 8 April 2024.

items.text: The Ley que regula los establecimientos dedicados a la producción, almacenamiento, distribución y enajenación de bebidas alcohólicas en el Estado de Nayarit (published 2 December 2022; last amendment in the Periódico Oficial of 15 September 2025) forbids producers, warehouses, distributors and retailers from allowing entry, or selling alcoholic drinks, to minors or to people with intellectual disability in any of the venue types under this law (art. 22 III, as reformed on 15 September 2025). The law says menores de edad and does not itself define that age.

Article 26 bans the sale of alcoholic drinks on the public street, in educational premises, hospitals, temples, sports fields, and in semi-fixed or itinerant establishments. In depots or mini-markets with groceries, self-service shops and supermarkets, beer and other alcoholic drinks may be sold only in the original closed bottle, and consumption inside the shop or on the pavement outside is banned (art. 23).

Article 28 sets statewide base hours: cantinas, bars and beer halls 10:00 to 20:00; nightclubs and discos with alcohol sales 20:00 to 01:00; party halls 14:00 to 01:00; restaurant-bars 10:00 to 24:00; social, sports and recreational clubs 10:00 to 24:00; self-service shops, mini-markets, grocery shops and closed-bottle retail 09:00 to 21:00; hotels and motels 09:00 to 24:00, independently of lodging hours; craft beer tasting rooms 10:00 to 24:00. The state finance secretariat may change the hours, set closing days, and authorise extensions; municipal presidents may propose changes, which need the Executive's agreement (art. 29).

psychoactive-substances.notes: This is state law on licensed production, storage, distribution and sale. The text read uses menores de edad and does not itself state 18 years. The Executive may change the base hours.
